# Consent form - TEMPLATE (not approved)

> **DRAFT TEMPLATE.** Not approved for use; must be reviewed by the designated data-protection reviewer and adapted to local requirements.
> Do not describe this form as legally compliant. A signed copy is a *private* record and is never stored in the repository or the speech dataset.
> Consent version: [CONSENT-VERSION]   Information sheet version: [INFORMATION-SHEET-VERSION]

Participant code (assigned by the project, not your name): SPK-____

Please tick each box that applies. You may take part even if you leave the optional boxes empty.

**Required to take part**
- [ ] I have read the information sheet and had the chance to ask questions.
- [ ] I understand taking part is voluntary and I can stop or withdraw at any time without any effect on unrelated services.
- [ ] I agree that my voice will be recorded and that the recordings and information derived from them will be processed for speech-recognition research as described. *(register field: recording_and_analysis)*
- [ ] I understand the recordings are kept until [RETENTION DATE] and then deleted unless I agree otherwise. *(retention_until)*
- [ ] I understand taking part does not mean the system will recognise words accurately.

**Optional (each is separate)**
- [ ] My recordings may be used in future experiments of this project. *(future_experiments)*
- [ ] My optional details (age group, gender, accent/region) may be used to report results by group. *(group_reporting_ok; also covers whether optional details are collected: optional_attributes_ok)*
- [ ] I agree to public release of my recordings. **Not offered in this study; leave empty.** *(public_release = no)*

Withdrawal: I can ask to withdraw by contacting [CONTACT METHOD]. I understand what can and cannot be deleted as described in the information sheet.
